SECTION B: (2 Marks Each)

Q22. In the given figure, PA and PB are tangents to the circle with centre O such that ∠APB = 50°. Write the measure of ∠OAB.

Answer / Solution:
In quadrilateral OAPB:
∠OAP = 90° and ∠OBP = 90° (radius ⟂ tangent)
So ∠AOB = 360° - (90° + 90° + 50°) = 130°
In ΔOAB, OA = OB, so base angles are equal:
∠OAB = ∠OBA = (180° - 130°)/2 = 25°
Answer: 25°
